property_summary: For any caller and any amount, sendTo only succeeds (does not revert) when invoked by the owner and, when the recipient reverts on receiving Ether, the reference C may revert due to transfer but the mutant (which omits the transfer) will not revert — therefore the property: when recipient reverts on payment, calling sendTo as owner MUST revert (reference) but the mutant will sometimes not revert.
change_summary: Remove the transfer call so function never attempts to send funds and therefore won't revert for transfer-related reasons.
